assay: bulk RNA-seq (50-bp SE, HiSeq 2500) of FACS-sorted Nestin-EGFP+ dentate gyrus NSCs and progeny; ATAC-seq and Egr1 ChIP-seq in the same series are not expression data
primary_estimand: Effect of voluntary wheel running (from weaning, P28, to 8w) on the NSC transcriptome of mice exposed to midazolam (MDZ) early in life: MDZ+RW vs MDZ at 8w (Fig. 7A-B, S7.p1)

factors.note: Ctrl+RW exists only for histology/behaviour (Fig. 7D-O); no Ctrl+RW RNA-seq deposited

sample_inclusion: 8w RNA-seq: Control_8w (n=3), MDZ_8w (n=3), RUN_MDZ_8w (n=3); each library pools 30,000 cells from 3-5 mice (S9.10.p1). P10 RNA-seq and in vitro Egr1/Ctrl NSC RNA-seq address other questions
planned_contrasts: MDZ+RW vs MDZ at 8w (Fig. 7B; paper reports only overlaps: 42 MDZ-up genes reversed down, 76 MDZ-down genes reversed up; no total DEG count)
MDZ vs Ctrl at 8w (Fig. 3E, S3.p1; 604 up, 873 down; needed for the Fig. 7B overlap)

paper_threshold.source_locator: FIG7 legend (B): fold change > 1.5, q < 0.05; S3.p1: q < 0.05, fold change >= 1.5

paper_method: featureCounts raw counts -> DESeq2 (S9.11.p1); TPM for display
